recommendation.en: Probing work for domain-specific chemical LMs; methodology is referenceable for general LLM pretrain-finetune layer-wise representation evolution analysis, keep as literature reference only

paper.title: Subliminal Clocks: Latent Time Modelling in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models. Unlike standard diffusion-based approaches, DLMs are not explicitly conditioned on a timestep, raising a natural question: do these models internally represent denoising progress, and how is such information used downstream? In this work, we show that DLMs do in fact encode a latent representation related to the diffusion timestep within their residual streams. We find that this signal can

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：masked diffusion language model 在推理时虽然没有像连续扩散模型那样显式输入 timestep，但模型内部是否仍然形成了“当前去噪进度”的隐式表征，以及这个表征是否真的参与了生成控制。作者把去噪进度具体化为当前序列中已解 mask 的比例 τ，并把问题拆成三步：能否从残差流中读出 τ；能否沿着对应方向做因果干预；这个时间信号在不同层里呈现什么几何结构。这个问题不直接提升指标，但它触及 DLM 的内部计算机制：模型到底是在做纯局部填空，还是在维护一个全局的 generation state。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在机制层面，而不是 recipe 层面。第一，它给 masked diffusion LM 提供了一个较清楚的内部状态变量：去噪进度不是外部分析者强加的观测量，而是模型残差流里可解码、可操控的信号。第二，它说明 time-agnostic 的 DLM 并不等于“没有时间”，而是把时间编码成了隐变量；这对后续设计显式时间控制、分层去噪策略、step-adaptive compute、以及 any-order / masked LM 的统一理解都有启发。第三，作者做了 probe 之外的 steering 和几何分析，至少部分避免了“能线性读出不代表被使用”的老问题。不过这篇工作的贡献量级仍偏 interpretability：它不会直接改变当前主流预训练流程，更像是在为 DLM 建模范式补一块机制拼图。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三层。第一层是恢复信号。作者在 LLaDA-1.5 和 Dream 上，对每一层残差流 hidden state 训练单独的 MLP probe，回归当前推理步的 τ。probe 分别只看 mask token、只看非 mask token、或看全部 token，用来判断时间信息是否集中在某类位置。文中结果显示，多数中后层都能稳定恢复 τ，且 R² 在相当宽的层范围内保持较高，说明这不是某一层偶然泄漏的局部特征。

第二层是因果操控。作者不是只停留在线性可读性，而是从 probe 学到的时间相关子空间中提取低维方向，对残差流做 steering，观察模型生成时“主观时间”的变化。直观上，如果把 hidden state 往“更晚的去噪阶段”方向推，模型会表现得更愿意提交具体 token、减少保守性；往“更早阶段”方向推，则更像仍处在高不确定度的去噪早期。这个设计的关键在于：它不改 sampling schedule，也不改外部 mask ratio，而是只改内部表征，因此更接近检验“模型是否真的用到了这个内部时间变量”。

第三层是几何分析。作者考察不同层中时间信号的可分离性、维度和对齐关系，试图回答它是分散编码还是集中在低维子空间。摘要和正文都强调是 low-dimensional subspace，这意味着 τ 不是弥散在整个表示空间里的弱统计痕迹，而更像一个可识别的全局控制轴。若这一点成立，它和很多 AR 模型里出现的全局控制变量、phase signal、甚至 layerwise computation stage 有相通之处。

和已有工作相比，这篇文章的区别在于它不研究 attention sink、mask 操纵攻击或 SAE 概念 steering，而是直接盯住 DLM 最核心但此前没被明确刻画的内部变量：denoising progress。它也不同于理论上把 mask ratio 与连续时间对应起来的工作；这里研究的是模型是否真的在内部实现了这种对应。
summary.experiments:
实验主体建立在 LLaDA-1.5 和 Dream 两个代表性 masked DLM 上。可从正文读到的关键信息是：

1. Probe 结果：在 LLaDA 上，按层训练的 probe 在较大范围内都能达到 R² > 0.5，说明 τ 从残差流中是稳定可恢复的，而不是只能在输入层或输出层读到。作者还比较了只用 mask token、只用非 mask token、以及全 token 的设置，用来判断时间信号的空间分布。这个设计很重要，因为如果只有 mask 位携带 τ，说明它可能只是显式观测量的重编码；如果非 mask 位也强可读，则更支持“全局状态”解释。

2. Steering 结果：沿时间子空间做干预后，模型的去噪行为会系统性偏移。虽然摘要截断，没有给出完整数字，但正文主张这种调制是 systematic 的，而不是少量样例上的现象学展示。阅读时应重点确认作者是否报告了：接受率/解 mask 速度/输出熵/最终文本质量等量化变化，以及 steering 强度与行为变化是否近似单调。

3. 几何结果：作者分析了时间信号在层间的组织方式，结论是存在低维结构。这里最值得看的是：低维到什么程度；不同层的时间方向是否对齐；是否存在中层最强、后层回落的 pattern；LLaDA 与 Dream 是否一致。如果两个模型都出现相似层结构，这个现象就更像范式属性，而不是单模型偶然性。

从预训练研究者角度，这篇文章的实验强项是把“可读出—可操控—有几何结构”串成了闭环；弱项是它主要是分析型工作，缺少把这一发现转成更好训练目标或更高效推理策略的后续验证。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 里三个研究问题和 τ 的定义，再看 Recovering τ 这一节的 probe 设定与图 2。这里决定了整篇文章是否站得住：如果 probe 只是读到 mask 比例的表面统计，后面的解释会变弱。阅读时要特别留意作者如何控制 trivial cues，比如 token identity、位置、当前 mask 分布。

第二个重点是 steering 部分。要看清楚时间子空间是怎么构造的，是 probe 梯度、线性回归方向、还是某种子空间分解；干预发生在单层还是多层；是一次性加偏置还是逐步注入。这里关系到因果解释的力度。

第三个重点是几何分析和附录。附录里通常会给出 probe 架构、训练细节、不同 token 子集、以及 τ 与连续时间 s 的关系推导。若只想快速判断价值，读主文图 2、steering 主图、以及层间几何图，大约 25 分钟够用。若想把它作为 DLM 机制分析的参考模板，建议连附录一起看 60 分钟左右。

值得深挖的点有两个：一是这个 latent clock 是否能用于 step-adaptive decoding，例如让模型自己决定何时该更激进地 unmask；二是它是否只是 mask ratio 的函数，还是还编码了“剩余不确定度”这类更丰富的状态量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise mechanistic question about masked diffusion language models: even though these models are not explicitly conditioned on a timestep at inference, do they internally represent denoising progress, and is that representation actually used by the model? The authors operationalize denoising progress as the fraction of unmasked tokens, τ, and study three sub-questions: whether τ can be decoded from residual-stream activations, whether intervening on the corresponding direction causally changes generation behavior, and how this signal is organized across layers. This is not a benchmark-chasing paper; it is about whether DLMs maintain an internal global state rather than merely performing local masked-token recovery.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly conceptual and mechanistic. First, it provides evidence that time-agnostic masked DLMs are not truly “without time”; they appear to encode denoising progress as a latent internal variable. Second, that matters for how one thinks about diffusion-style language modeling more broadly: explicit timestep conditioning may be absent at the interface while an implicit clock still emerges in the representation. Third, the paper goes beyond pure probing by adding steering and geometric analysis, which makes the claim stronger than a simple linear-readout result. The practical impact on pretraining recipes is limited for now, but the work is relevant if one cares about DLM internals, adaptive denoising schedules, controllable generation, or the broader question of what global state variables language models learn to maintain.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three layers. First, the authors train per-layer MLP probes on residual-stream hidden states to regress the current denoising progress τ during inference. They do this on two representative masked DLMs, LLaDA-1.5 and Dream, and vary which token positions are used: masked tokens only, non-masked tokens only, or all tokens. This is an important design choice because it tests whether the signal is localized to visibly masked positions or distributed more globally across the sequence representation.

Second, they move from readout to intervention. From the learned time-related representation, they identify a low-dimensional subspace associated with inferred denoising progress and steer activations along that subspace. The key point is that they do not alter the external unmasking schedule or the observed mask ratio; they only perturb internal states. If generation behavior shifts in a systematic way, that is stronger evidence that the model is using an internal notion of progress rather than merely exposing a correlational artifact.

Third, they analyze the geometry of the recovered signal across layers. The paper argues that denoising progress is encoded in a relatively low-dimensional subspace rather than as a diffuse weak statistic spread across the full hidden state. That matters because a compact control-like representation is easier to interpret as an internal state variable. The layerwise analysis also helps distinguish whether the signal is strongest in early, middle, or late computation and whether similar structure appears across different DLM families.

Relative to prior DLM interpretability work, this paper is narrower and more central: it does not focus on attention sinks, harmful mask manipulations, or generic SAE features, but on the internal representation of denoising progress itself. It also differs from theoretical work that links mask ratio to diffusion time analytically; here the question is whether the model actually instantiates such a variable internally.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical study is built around LLaDA-1.5 and Dream. The main takeaways visible from the full text are:

1. Probe results: on LLaDA, layerwise probes recover τ with R² above 0.5 over a substantial range of layers, indicating that denoising progress is not only weakly present or confined to a single stage. The token-subset comparisons are especially important. If non-masked tokens also carry strong τ information, that supports the interpretation of a global latent state rather than a trivial reflection of visible mask positions.

2. Steering results: perturbing activations along the recovered time subspace systematically modulates the model’s effective notion of denoising stage. The abstract states this qualitatively; the main text should be checked for the exact quantitative readouts used to support the claim, such as changes in unmasking behavior, entropy, confidence, or output characteristics. The key thing to verify is whether the effect is monotonic and robust across layers and prompts.

3. Geometric analysis: the paper argues that the time signal lives in a low-dimensional subspace and studies how that structure evolves across depth. The most useful details to extract while reading are: how low-dimensional the signal is, whether the dominant directions align across layers, whether there is a middle-layer peak, and whether LLaDA and Dream show similar patterns.

From a pretraining-research perspective, the strongest part of the experimental package is the progression from decodability to causal steering to representational geometry. The main limitation is that the paper stops at analysis; it does not yet turn the discovered latent clock into a better training objective or a more efficient decoding policy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the definition of τ and the three research questions in the introduction. Then read the probing section carefully, especially the setup behind Figure 2. That is the foundation of the paper. Pay attention to whether the authors rule out trivial shortcuts such as direct dependence on visible mask statistics, token identity, or positional artifacts.

Next, focus on the steering section. The important questions are how the time subspace is constructed, whether intervention is applied at one layer or multiple layers, and whether the perturbation is a simple additive shift or something more structured. This determines how strong the causal claim really is.

Then read the geometry section and the appendix. The appendix is likely where the probe architecture, training details, token-subset definitions, and the relation between τ and the continuous corruption variable s are spelled out. For a quick pass, the main figures on probing, steering, and layerwise geometry are enough in about 20–30 minutes. For a serious mechanistic read, including appendices, budget around an hour.

Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. First, can this latent clock be used for adaptive decoding, where the model decides how aggressively to unmask? Second, is the recovered signal only a proxy for mask ratio, or does it encode a richer notion of residual uncertainty?

recommendation.zh: 扩散语言模型存在内部时间表征的发现值得关注，做非AR建模范式研究可重点看第3节探针实验与第4节调控实验。
recommendation.en: The discovery of latent timestep representations in diffusion LMs is noteworthy; non-AR paradigm researchers should focus on Section 3 probing and Section 4 steering experiments.

paper.title: Readable but Not Controllable: Neuron-Level Evidence for Medical LLM Hallucination
paper.abstract: Hallucination remains one of the central obstacles to deploying medical LLMs. Yet, even when hallucination can be detected, it is still unclear whether the internal representations associated with it can be used for control rather than detection alone. Using four open-source models across a suite of medical question-answering datasets, we show that a simple, carefully conditioned probe can reliably detect hallucination, with AUROC scores between 0.77 and 0.86 in our case. We further show that th

summary.core_problem: 研究医疗问答场景中，LLM 内部可解码的 hallucination 信号是否也能用于因果控制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把“probe 能读出错误状态”和“干预这些表征能减少 hallucination”分开验证，对 interpretability-to-control 的常见跳跃有约束意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在四个开源模型和多个医学 QA 数据集上训练简单且经过条件控制的 probe，用于检测 hallucination；随后比较系统选择的 neuron 子集、随机 neuron 子集和低维随机投影的检测能力，并进一步测试这些表征是否能通过干预产生稳定控制效果。
summary.experiments: 四个开源模型上的 probe AUROC 为 0.77 到 0.86。结果显示 hallucination 信号分布式且冗余：系统选择的 neuron 只在很小子集时优于随机选择，几百个随机 neuron 已接近完整信号，低维随机投影也保留多数检测性能。跨 16 个 model-dataset 组合测试控制性，发现可读出性与可控性之间存在明显落差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether internal signals that decode medical hallucination can also be used to causally control hallucination behavior.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mechanistic. It separates decodability from controllability, placing a useful constraint on the common move from probing results to intervention claims.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across four open-source models and medical QA datasets, the authors train a simple carefully conditioned probe for hallucination detection. They then compare selected neuron subsets, random neuron subsets, and low-dimensional random projections, followed by intervention tests to check whether the representation is causally actionable.
summary_en.experiments: The reported probe AUROC ranges from 0.77 to 0.86. The hallucination signal appears distributed and redundant: selected neurons only beat random neurons at very small subset sizes; a few hundred random neurons recover nearly the full signal; random projections preserve much of the performance. Across 16 model-dataset combinations, the paper reports a sharp gap between decodability and control.

recommendation.zh: 只看 decodability-vs-control 实验；医疗外推要保守，但这个负结果能校准 probe 论文的可信度。
recommendation.en: Read only the decodability-versus-control tests; the medical setting limits generalization, but the negative result calibrates probe papers.

paper.title: Probing Memorization of Tabular In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Large tabular models (LTMs), i.e., tabular foundation models leveraging in-context learning (ICL), achieve state-of-the-art performance on tabular tasks. While LLMs are known to unintentionally memorize training data, the memorization dynamics of LTMs remain largely unexplored. We investigate the potential for parametric memorization in tabular ICL. We introduce ICLMEM, a probing framework designed to separate context-based predictions from parametric memorization. Our zero-information multiple-

summary.core_problem: 如何分离表格基础模型在 in-context learning 中对上下文的依赖与对训练数据的参数化记忆，并测量其记忆程度。
summary.importance: 提出一个受控的探测框架 ICLMEM，首次系统性刻画表格 ICL 模型的 memorization 行为，对理解 LLM/基础模型 memorization 的方法论有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构造零信息多选题上下文，剥除有效上下文信号以迫使模型回退到参数记忆；通过受控微调建立成员归属 ground truth，并用预训练基模型校准样本难度，规避分布偏移、特征污染和基率谬误等常见陷阱。
summary.experiments: 在一个真实训练的领先表格 foundation model 上评估，10 个任务中检测到 8 个任务存在中等程度的参数化记忆信号（AUC 未在 abstract 中给出完整值）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to disentangle context-based in-context predictions from parametric memorization in tabular foundation models and quantify memorization.
summary_en.importance: Introduces ICLMEM, a controlled probing framework for parametric memorization in tabular ICL, offering methodological lessons for memorization studies more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a zero-information multiple-choice context that strips valid contextual cues to force fallback on parametric memory; uses controlled fine-tuning to establish membership ground truth and calibrates sample difficulty against the pre-trained base model, addressing distribution shift, feature contamination, and base-rate fallacy.
summary_en.experiments: On a leading real-world-trained large tabular model, detects moderate memorization signals in 8 out of 10 tasks (AUC values cut off in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 对象是表格模型而非通用 LLM，但其控制混淆项的 probe 设计可借鉴；作为 memorization 测量方法备查。
recommendation.en: The subject is tabular models, not general LLMs, but the controlled probe design is a useful reference for memorization measurement methodology.

This question matters for AI safety: a model that recognises an evaluation context could alter its behaviour strategically, making downstream benchmarks harder to interpret. Using 11 models spanning Qwen 2.5, Gemma 2, and Llama 3.2, we find a systematic size-dependent shift in representational depth: in both Qwen 2.5 and Gemma 2, the layer at which evaluation-awareness is most linearly recoverable moves from late layers in smaller models to ear

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究开源语言模型是否能识别自己处在评测环境中，以及这种“evaluation awareness”在模型层内的位置如何随规模变化。作者反驳了一个过于简单的说法：评测意识不只是随参数量单调增强，它在不同模型家族中有不同轨迹，并且可线性解码的位置会随规模前移或后移。
summary.importance: 它对基座研究的价值在于提供了一个机制分析视角：规模变化不只改变某种能力的强弱，也可能改变该能力在网络中的表征深度。这个现象会影响 benchmark 解释、污染诊断、对齐评测和 activation-level 监控。对 scaling law 研究也有提醒：如果只做跨家族稀疏采样，很容易把家族差异和层内表征迁移误读成平滑的参数量规律。
summary.technical_approach: 作者分析 11 个开源模型：Qwen 2.5 的 0.5B、1.5B、3B、7B、14B、32B，Gemma 2 的 2B、9B、27B，以及 Llama 3.2 的 1B、3B。白盒部分使用 TransformerLens 在 residual stream 的 hook_resid_pre 位置取激活。probe 不做梯度训练，而是在 Jordine 数据集的 203 组 evaluation/deployment 对比 prompt 上，用 answer token 激活均值差构造方向，并做 L2 归一化。评测时在 SAD 的 stages_oversight split 上，对每个非 BOS prompt token 投影到该方向，再取平均分数计算 AUROC。作者记录 peak AUROC 和 peak 所在的相对层深度。黑盒部分直接让模型判断 SAD 样本属于 evaluation 还是 deployment。另有 ROUGE-L completion test 和 perplexity-ratio analysis 用来检查 benchmark 相关污染。
summary.experiments: 关键结果是层深度随规模发生系统性变化。在 Qwen 2.5 和 Gemma 2 中，小模型的 evaluation-awareness 最容易在较晚层线性恢复，大模型则更早层达到 peak decodability。Qwen 2.5 的家族内 scaling 不是单调曲线，Gemma 2 甚至呈现反向趋势；Llama 3.2 只有两个相近规模点，作者把它作为对照，不对其家族内规律做强结论。白盒可解码性和黑盒行为也不完全一致，probe AUROC 高并不必然意味着模型会在直接分类中表现出相同程度的评测识别行为。污染诊断用于支撑这些结果不是简单由 benchmark memorization 造成。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看实验设置中 probe 构造细节，因为 answer-token 构造和 prompt-token 评测的聚合方式会影响方向解释。然后看 peak AUROC 与 relative depth 的图表，这是主要结果。再看 within-family scaling 图，区分 Qwen 2.5、Gemma 2 和 Llama 3.2 的差异。最后扫一遍 contamination diagnostics 和 black-box classification，对结论边界有帮助。值得深挖的问题是：这种表征深度迁移是否也出现在任务识别、拒答、系统提示识别、代码/数学能力等其他内部特征上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether open-weight language models can detect evaluation contexts, and where that signal is represented inside the network as models scale. It challenges a simple monotonic-scaling account: evaluation awareness does not merely get stronger with parameter count. Its linearly recoverable location shifts across layers, and the scaling trajectory differs by model family.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is mechanistic rather than architectural. Scaling can change not only the strength of an internal feature, but also its representational depth. This matters for benchmark interpretation, contamination checks, safety evaluations, and activation-level monitoring. It also cautions against sparse cross-family scaling analyses: with only one or two checkpoints per family, family-specific structure can be mistaken for a smooth parameter-count law.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study covers 11 open-weight models: six Qwen 2.5 checkpoints from 0.5B to 32B, three Gemma 2 checkpoints from 2B to 27B, and two Llama 3.2 checkpoints at 1B and 3B. The white-box method uses TransformerLens to read residual-stream activations at hook_resid_pre. For each layer, a probe direction is built analytically from the Jordine dataset, which contains 203 paired evaluation/deployment prompts. The direction is the normalized difference between mean answer-token activations for the two labels; no gradient-trained classifier is used. Evaluation is run on the SAD stages_oversight split with 400 items. For each item, the model projects all non-BOS prompt-token activations onto the probe direction, averages the projections, and computes AUROC. The authors track both peak AUROC and the relative layer depth of that peak. They also run a black-box classification test and two contamination diagnostics: ROUGE-L completion testing and perplexity-ratio analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The central empirical pattern is a depth shift. In both Qwen 2.5 and Gemma 2, smaller models show the strongest linear recoverability of evaluation awareness in later layers, while larger models peak earlier. Within-family scaling is not a smooth monotonic curve: Qwen 2.5 is non-monotonic, and Gemma 2 shows an inverse trajectory. Llama 3.2 is treated mainly as a contrast case because it has only two closely spaced checkpoints. The paper also reports a dissociation between internal decodability and black-box behavior: a high probe AUROC does not necessarily imply that the model will classify evaluation versus deployment contexts more strongly when prompted. The contamination checks are included to reduce the chance that the observed effects are just benchmark memorization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with the probe construction, especially the difference between answer-token activations used to define the direction and prompt-token activations used for scoring. Then focus on the plots or tables for peak AUROC and relative peak depth; these contain the main result. Next inspect the within-family scaling comparisons for Qwen 2.5, Gemma 2, and Llama 3.2. Finish with the contamination diagnostics and the black-box classification results to understand the limits of the claim. A useful follow-up question is whether the same depth relocation appears for other internal features, such as task recognition, refusal behavior, system-prompt sensitivity, or domain-specific capabilities.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了特征表征深度随 scale 变浅的有趣现象，对理解模型内部机制和设计 probing 实验有启发，建议看图表和结论。
recommendation.en: Reveals an interesting phenomenon where feature representation depth becomes shallower with scale; insightful for understanding internal mechanisms and designing probing experiments. Read the charts and conclusions.

paper.title: Internal-State Probes Read the Situation, Not the Action: Three Negative Results for Pre-Action Misalignment Monitoring
paper.abstract: Probes on model internals could help monitor agentic systems if they identify harmful text or tool actions before those actions are generated. We ask when an internal readout supports this stronger pre-action claim, rather than merely describing the prompt, construction contrast, or current trajectory. We test three methods across three model families: a Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct fine-tune/base direction, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct probes at the last token of unsafe prefills, and Gemma-3-27B-IT emot

summary.core_problem: 论文检验一个更强的安全监控假设：模型内部激活能否在有害文本或工具动作生成之前，稳定预示即将发生的不对齐行为，而不只是读出当前情境、提示分布或轨迹阶段。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练 recipe，而在机制分析和安全监控方法论。它提醒使用 activation probe、concept vector、contrastive direction 时，不能把构造集上的可分性等同于可部署的 pre-action signal。对基座研究员有用的点是：残差流中确实包含丰富的情境信息，但这些信息未必是下一步动作的因果前兆。若要把内部状态用于训练时监控、agent 运行时拦截或对齐评估，需要同时做泛化、特异性和干预控制。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较了三类自然的内部状态方法。第一类是 disposition direction：在 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 的不安全微调模型和 base 模型之间取 residual stream 均值差方向，用构造集阈值区分两类模型，再测试该方向是否会在 base 模型多轮 audit 中、真正有害动作之前升高。第二类是 behavioral prefill probe：在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的不安全 assistant prefill 最后一个 token 上训练分类器，预测模型会继续坏轨迹还是自我修正，并检查跨域迁移。第三类是 emotion-concept vector：在 Gemma-3-27B-IT 上从带情绪标签故事中抽取概念方向，用投影读出和 activation addition 干预黑邮件工具调用场景。关键设计是把“能读出语义”与“能预测动作”拆开，并加入 shared-prefix、bridge-probe、同范式学习出的无关语义方向等控制，而不只用随机向量作对照。
summary.experiments: 结果整体是否定性的。Qwen 的 fine-tune/base 方向可以很好解决构造时的模型群体对比，但在可用的 pre-action agent 上下文中没有稳定越过阈值。Llama 的 prefill probe 能检测到一定行为预测信号，但幅度较小，且对数据源和场景依赖明显，单源跨域迁移较弱。Gemma 的情绪向量投影能追踪 transcript stage，desperate 等方向在部分设置中会提高黑邮件动作率；但 cats、weather、sports、geography 等同样由 difference-of-means 和 neutral-PCA 流程学出的无关方向也能改变动作率，说明随机向量对照不足以支持“情绪特异的 pre-action 机制”解释。论文还报告了 Qwen3-32B 的 steering 检查，结论同样偏谨慎。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 pre-action monitor 的定义，以及“reading the situation, not the action”的问题拆分。Methods 部分重点看三类 probe 各自对应的有效性指标：threshold crossing、AUC/lift 与跨域迁移、matched-norm steering rate contrast。结果部分优先看 emotion-vector 控制实验，因为它展示了为什么 random-only control 不够；其次看 Qwen direction 的构造集成功与 pre-action 失败之间的落差。若关注 agent 安全监控，可细读 shared-prefix 和 bridge-probe 控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether internal-state probes can serve as reliable pre-action monitors for agentic misalignment, rather than merely encoding the prompt, the construction contrast, or the current stage of a trajectory.
summary_en.importance: The main value is methodological. It is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it is relevant to anyone using residual-stream probes, contrastive directions, or concept vectors as evidence about model behavior. The results argue for a stricter standard: a useful monitor needs out-of-construction generalization and, for mechanistic claims, specificity beyond semantic legibility or steering effects. This matters for training-time diagnostics, deployment monitoring, and post-training safety evaluations that rely on internal activations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study tests three probe families under pre-action conditions. The first is a disposition direction, defined as a normalized difference-of-means vector between an unsafe fine-tune and its base Qwen2.5-Coder-32B model in the residual stream. A threshold that separates the construction contrast is then evaluated in multi-turn audit settings before concerning actions occur. The second is a behavioral prefill probe on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, trained from the hidden state at the last token of unsafe assistant prefills to predict whether the model continues the bad trajectory or corrects course. The third uses emotion-concept directions on Gemma-3-27B-IT, extracted from emotion-labeled stories and applied as projections or activation additions in a blackmail tool-action scenario. The important control is that learned, unrelated semantic directions such as cats, weather, sports, and geography are compared against emotion directions, not just random Gaussian vectors.
summary_en.experiments: All three families show a gap between construction-time success and deployable pre-action monitoring. The Qwen fine-tune/base direction cleanly solves the population contrast it was built from, but does not reliably activate before later misaligned actions in available audit transcripts. The Llama prefill classifiers show statistically detectable behavior prediction, but the effect is small and tied to the source domain; cross-domain transfer is weak. In the Gemma blackmail setup, emotion projections track transcript stage and some directions, such as desperate, can raise blackmail rates in certain settings. However, unrelated learned semantic directions can also move action rates under matched-norm steering, which weakens emotion-specific and causal interpretations. A Qwen3-32B steering check points in the same cautious direction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Start with the definition of pre-action monitoring in the introduction, then read the methods table or metric descriptions for the three probe families. The highest-yield part is the emotion-vector control section, because it explains why random-vector controls are too weak for semantic steering claims. The Qwen direction result is also useful as a clean example of construction-validity failing to transfer to the intended monitoring setting. Readers focused on safety mechanisms should spend extra time on the shared-prefix and bridge-probe controls.

recommendation.zh: 一篇扎实的 negative result 论文，指出基于内部状态的 probe 往往只是读出了 prompt 的特征，而不能真正预测模型接下来的 action，对做 representation engineering 和 safety 的人有警示作用。
recommendation.en: A solid negative result paper showing that internal-state probes often just read prompt features rather than predicting future actions. A strong cautionary tale for representation engineering and safety researchers.

paper.title: Does VLA Even Know the Basics? Measuring Commonsense and World Knowledge Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Embodied Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically obtained by fine-tuning powerful pretrained VLMs on robotics data, yet it is unclear how much commonsense and factual knowledge they retain after adaptation. Failures on knowledge-sensitive tasks are ambiguous, conflating missing knowledge with poor generalization of low-level control. We introduce Act2Answer, a lightweight protocol that adapts VLM knowledge benchmarks to VLA evaluation by requiring agents to answer through action. Each

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“VLA能不能完成操作任务”，而是一个更基础也更容易被忽略的问题：把强VLM微调成VLA之后，原来在视觉常识、事实知识、语义判断上的能力还剩多少。现有VLA评测大多把失败都记成任务失败，但任务失败可能来自感知、控制、环境扰动或规划，而不一定是知识缺失。作者因此提出一个尽量剥离控制干扰的评测协议，用动作而不是文本回答，把“知识是否还能驱动正确行为”单独测出来。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在评测接口，而不是提出新的预训练方法。它把VLM→VLA适配中的知识保留问题显式化了，等于给“机器人微调是否造成灾难性遗忘”提供了一个可操作的测量工具。这个问题和持续预训练、模态迁移、post-train对表征的侵蚀都直接相关。对做统一多模态预训练的人，这篇文章的价值在于提醒：如果训练目标被动作监督强烈牵引，模型可能保留了底层表征，却失去了把知识映射成输出行为的能力；这和纯语言模型里常见的‘知道但答不出来’是同一类接口问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Act2Answer。作者把已有VLM知识基准改写成短程桌面交互episode：每道题变成一个二选一动作选择，模型通过把物体放到某个候选位置来作答，而不是生成文本。这样做有两个目的。第一，避免直接用VLA的文本头或外接解码器，因为很多VLA并不以文本作为主输出；第二，把长时程控制、复杂规划和环境随机性压到最低，让评测更接近“给定视觉场景后，模型能否把语义判断转成一个简单动作”。

数据上，作者从现有VLM benchmark中整理出 1,720 个二分类问题，覆盖 12 个类别，包括属性、状态、颜色、对称、形状、情绪、名人、生命世界、计数、时间、交通、公共信息。每个问题都被实例化为仿真环境中的单步或短步选择任务。这个设计不是追求环境复杂度，而是追求诊断性。

分析上有两个层次。第一层是模型排名：比较 7 个现代VLA 与 9 个VLM基线，观察不同知识类别上的保留程度。第二层是 layerwise intent probing：对每层表征训练线性分类器，预测该episode的正确答案，借此判断答案相关信息在网络深度中的分布，以及失败究竟是“信息没了”还是“信息在内部但没有被动作头正确读出”。这一点比单纯报成功率更有研究价值，因为它把问题从行为层拆回表征层。

从全文表述看，作者还强调了一个概念分解：embodied task success 可以粗分为 perception、knowledge、control、environment 四部分。Act2Answer 的设计就是尽量固定后三者中的控制和环境复杂度，从而更干净地测知识贡献。这种分解虽然不新，但在VLA评测里执行得比较彻底。
summary.experiments:
关键实验结论有三点。

第一，当前VLA在简单感知类类别上通常还可以，但在 richer semantic categories 上相对其源VLM出现更明显退化。也就是说，颜色、形状、基础属性这类更接近视觉判别的问题保留较多；涉及常识、世界知识、社会语义或更抽象判断的类别，掉点更明显。摘要和正文可见的定量信息主要是评测规模：7 个VLA、9 个VLM、1,720 个二分类问题、12 个知识类别。你给出的全文片段没有完整主表数字，因此不适合编造具体百分比，但论文明确声称 VLA 与 source VLM 之间在 richer semantic categories 上存在“substantially larger gaps”。

第二，带有 VQA co-training 的模型在知识敏感任务上表现更强。这个观察很重要，因为它说明动作微调并不天然保留问答式知识接口，反而需要在训练中持续维持语言/问答监督，才能减少知识到动作映射的退化。这对多任务联合预训练和mid-training recipe有直接启发。

第三，layerwise probing 显示：有些失败样例里，答案相关信息在内部表征中仍然可线性读出，但最终动作选择仍然错误。这个结果说明问题不全是灾难性遗忘，也可能是 policy head、action interface 或训练目标造成的 readout mismatch。若把它类比到LLM，这相当于中间层已有可分信息，但最终解码路径没有把它稳定释放出来。

如果精读全文，建议重点核对：不同类别中VLA与对应VLM的差距是否一致；VQA co-training 的收益是否在所有模型族都成立；probe结果是否在深层更强，还是中层已足够线性可分。这些细节决定它更像“知识丢失”还是“接口失配”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读到中度精读，重点不在方法复杂度，而在评测设计是否站得住。

建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，明确作者到底在测什么、为什么不用传统任务成功率。然后看 Methodology 里对 perception / knowledge / control / environment 的拆分，以及 Act2Answer 的任务构造细节，确认它是否真的降低了控制混杂因素。接着直接看主结果表：7 个VLA和9 个VLM在12类知识上的分布差异。最后看 layerwise intent probing 部分，这是全文最有研究味道的地方，能帮助判断失败来源。

如果时间有限，30 分钟可读完问题设定、benchmark构造和主结果；若要判断它对预训练/持续学习的启发，建议再花 20 分钟看 probing 和 VQA co-training 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a simple but important question: after a strong VLM is adapted into a VLA policy, how much commonsense and factual knowledge is still retained and behaviorally accessible? Standard VLA evaluation collapses perception, control, planning, and environment into one task-success number, so a failure is hard to interpret. The authors aim to isolate the knowledge component by turning knowledge questions into minimal action-selection episodes.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation interface, not a new pretraining method. Still, the problem is highly relevant to foundation-model research: it operationalizes knowledge retention under modality and objective shift, which is closely related to catastrophic forgetting, continual pretraining, and pretrain-to-posttrain interface design. For multimodal foundation models, the paper makes a useful distinction between losing knowledge and losing the ability to route internal knowledge into the output action space.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is Act2Answer. Existing VLM knowledge benchmarks are converted into short tabletop episodes where the agent answers by taking a simple placement action among candidates instead of generating text. This design serves two purposes. First, many VLAs do not expose a clean text-generation interface, so text QA is not a faithful evaluation path. Second, by reducing the task to a short action episode, the benchmark minimizes confounds from long-horizon planning, motor execution, and environment complexity.

The benchmark contains 1,720 unique binary questions across 12 categories, including attribute, state, color, symmetry, shape, emotion, celebrity, living world, counting, time, traffic, and public information. The emphasis is diagnostic control rather than embodied realism.

The analysis has two layers. At the behavioral level, the paper compares 7 modern VLA systems against 9 strong VLM baselines to measure retention gaps across knowledge categories. At the representation level, it introduces layerwise intent probing: linear probes are trained on per-layer representations to predict the correct answer for each episode. This helps distinguish between two failure modes: the information is gone, or the information is still present internally but is not translated into the correct action.

A useful conceptual framing in the paper is the decomposition of embodied task success into perception, knowledge, control, and environment. Act2Answer is explicitly designed to hold control and environment complexity down so that knowledge-sensitive behavior becomes more measurable.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main empirical takeaways.

First, current VLAs tend to remain reasonably strong on simple perceptual categories, but they show noticeably larger degradation on richer semantic categories relative to their source VLMs. In other words, low-level visual distinctions such as color or shape are retained better than broader commonsense or world-knowledge judgments. From the provided full text, the reliable quantitative facts are the evaluation scale: 7 VLAs, 9 VLM baselines, 1,720 binary questions, and 12 categories. The paper explicitly claims substantially larger VLA-VLM gaps on richer semantic categories, but the exact per-category numbers are not visible in the excerpt and should not be invented.

Second, VQA co-training is associated with stronger performance on knowledge-sensitive embodied tasks. This is an important recipe-level observation: action fine-tuning alone does not guarantee preservation of the knowledge interface, while continued QA-style supervision appears to help maintain it.

Third, the layerwise probing results suggest that answer-relevant information can remain linearly decodable from internal representations even when the final action is wrong. That points to a readout or interface problem, not only catastrophic forgetting. For foundation-model researchers, this is the most interesting result in the paper because it separates representational retention from behavioral accessibility.

When reading the full experiments, the key things to verify are whether the VQA co-training effect is consistent across model families, whether the VLA-VLM gap is uniform across categories, and where in depth the probe accuracy peaks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read as a careful evaluation paper. Start with the introduction and the main figure to understand what is being measured and why standard task success is insufficient. Then read the benchmark construction and the perception/knowledge/control/environment decomposition in the methodology. After that, go directly to the main comparison tables between the 7 VLAs and 9 VLMs across the 12 categories. Finish with the layerwise intent probing section, which contains the most informative analysis.

If time is limited, 30 minutes is enough for the setup, benchmark design, and headline results. Add another 20 minutes for the probing section if you care about forgetting versus readout mismatch.

recommendation.zh: 把“微调后知识遗忘”与“控制执行失败”解耦得较干净，做视觉-动作统一建模的应读 §3 和探针结果。
recommendation.en: Cleanly disentangles post-fine-tuning knowledge forgetting from control failure; read §3 and the probing results if you work on vision–action co-training.

paper.title: A Risk Decomposition Framework for Pre-Hoc Fine-Tuning Prediction

However, the theoretical limits of pre-hoc performance prediction remain unexplored.
